newsitem.title: GERMANY: HWWA Institute sees German growth at 2.5 pct in 97.
newsitem.headline: HWWA Institute sees German growth at 2.5 pct in 97.

text.p: The German economy will match official forecasts to grow 2.5 percent in 1997, but the budget deficit will overshoot European monetary union targets at 3-1/4 percent of economic output, a research body said on Monday.

The HWWA institute in Hamburg said in a report it expected an average unemployment rate of 10.8 percent -- equivalent to 4.15 million workers and just under the Bonn government's forecast of 4.2 million.
